title: Take Back Your Power: Vote Libertarian
description: Do you believe in peace, prosperity, and freedom? Are you tired of voting for the lesser of two evils? Vote for @JoJorgensenforPresident2020. Pledge your vote at http://my.lp.org/vote to join thousands of other Americans looking for real change this November 3rd.
transcript: - Have you ever asked yourself,why are Americans so divided, so angry?It's because partisan bullies, Republican and Democratprofit by pushing us apart, stoking our fearsand feeding off the hate.They want to keep us divided and fightingso that we don't notice that they never ever get aroundto solving our country's problems.I'm Jo Jorgensen, and I'm a Libertarianbecause I know there's a better way.I'm a Libertarian because I believe in the unstoppablepower of free people working together to solve problems.This is what makes America unique and special,not partisan power playsand one size fits all Washington dictates.We want you to have your power back.The power to think and act for yourself.I'm a Libertarian because I don't believe that politicianscan mandate your dignity or legislate mutual respect.These are things that you and I have to work for.Washington, can't do it for us.Can you imagine what we could all do together,if we just walked away from those old broken partiesand their cynical game?The Republicans and Democrats want to divide us,but I see a beautiful opportunity.Each of us, free individuals,bringing our unique experience and abilities,our hopes and dreams to the table.The Democrats and Republicans don't want you to hear this.And you know why?Because they only win, if we stay divided,angry and hopeless.But let's be honest, the partisan bullies in Washingtondon't know us and they don't care about us.They just care about power.Let's call their bluff.For all of our disagreements, we are bound by common values.Values like freedom, tolerance, peaceful cooperation,and mutual respect.Don't waste your vote this election.Vote Libertarian.I'm Jo Jorgensen, and I approve this message.
